backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only the signal-date earnings snapshot plus close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date. 2_history_check.frozen_lanes_avoided: No LLM soft ranking, Form4 retry, Companyfacts scalar mining, accepted helper source-priority extension, 52-week source extension, macro/VIXY retune, or state-surface notional/profile retune is involved.
2_history_check.nearby_event_trials: exp-20260602-026 accepted post-earnings underpriced drift, while exp-20260607-013 and exp-20260609-024 peer/upcoming prewarm variants were rejected. This run is direct issuer pre-event low-bar evidence, not peer transfer.
2_history_check.nearby_pre_earnings_trial: exp-20260610-011 tested days_to_earnings 6-12 plus positive historical surprise and liquid leadership; it was rejected. This run is not a DTE sweep because it adds the PIT low-bar EPS field.
2_history_check.nearby_revision_trials: exp-20260605-029 and exp-20260606-016 tested positive revision trajectory variants and were rejected or weak; exp-20260609-011 accepted a low-extension revision+surprise helper. This run avoids estimate-revision threshold tuning and tests estimate level versus last actual EPS before the upcoming event.

gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: One fixed policy bundle: signal-date earnings snapshot days_to_earnings 6-30, positive average historical surprise, positive EPS estimate and last actual EPS, EPS estimate at least 5% and at most 75% below last actual EPS, liquid sector-known stock universe, existing 20d/60d SPY-relative leadership gates, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, top-1 next-open paper entry, five-day hold, cost, cooldown, and concentration gates.
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Treat as a positive replay lead only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window appears, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and the accepted exp-20260608-013 compression comparator is beaten. It is not accepted into production without a shared default-off helper.

hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: liquid stocks with an upcoming earnings event, positive historical surprise, and a point-in-time low analyst bar where EPS estimate is below last actual EPS may have more executable pre-earnings drift than generic DTE leadership. It uses only free earnings snapshots and OHLCV fields known by the signal date.
interpretation: The pre-earnings low-bar leadership source was rejected; it did not establish a distinct free earnings-calendar/OHLCV candidate-pool edge under the standard three-window protocol.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that EPS estimate versus last actual is not a clean seasonal low-bar proxy, the pre-earnings drift is already priced, or the low-bar subset still behaves like generic liquid momentum after next-open execution, costs, five-day hold, cooldown, and concentration controls.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially better pre-event expectation evidence such as same-quarter seasonal estimate history, analyst-count breadth, option-implied move with three-window coverage, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not retry by sweeping DTE, low-bar-gap, surprise, ret20/ret60, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping days-to-earnings windows, low-bar gap, historical surprise threshold, ret20/ret60 relative-strength thresholds, signal-day return, close-location, volume-ratio bounds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially better pre-event expectation evidence such as same-quarter seasonal estimate history, analyst-count breadth, option-implied move with three-window coverage, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not retry by sweeping DTE, low-bar-gap, surprise, ret20/ret60, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed pre-earnings low-bar leadership bundle failed Gate 4. The result implies the EPS-estimate-vs-last-actual low-bar field did not add enough distinct edge beyond liquid pre-earnings momentum under next-open execution, costs, five-day hold, cooldown, and overlap/concentration controls.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that loads the same point-in-time earnings snapshot for the signal date, applies the same days-to-earnings 6-30, positive historical-surprise, and EPS low-bar gates, sector-known liquid stock universe, SPY-relative leadership gates, close-quality gates, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, five-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, accepted compression comparator, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
